quotes.text: ‘Come on, girls,’ said Steve, ‘be honest, we won.’ / ‘Yeah,’ said Raymond, ‘we let you off because you’re girls.’ / ‘You’re unbelievable,’ said Liz. / ‘Well, if we’re unbelievable,’ said Steve, ‘then you’re unbelievabler.’
quotes.reference: 1996, Colin Thompson, “Four Pigeons”, in Venus the Caterpillar and Further Wild Stories, London: Hodder Children’s Books, →ISBN, page 24:

senses.definition: (figuratively) Amazing, astonishing; so surprising that one is almost, or figuratively, unable to believe.
examples: The most unbelievable thing happened to me today!

quotes.text: Whether you want the unbelievablest sheer of chiffon . . . or the most durable of service weight . . . I’ve concluded, after a round of looking, that these stores give you a real money’s worth!

quotes.text: In other words—join the gpo and hear the world; have fun; talk to the wildest, craziest, simply unbelievablest people.
